topology.logical_database_isolation: one local Turso database file per Native logical database

native.domain-mcp.v1.contract: deterministic TursoHarness lifecycle, link add and outbound listing, visibility, authorized history, event-chain replay, guarded-write, and isolation slice
native.domain-mcp.v1.notes: Partial aggregate claims are advisory only and never admit a strict operation without a full operation-scoped capability. Lifecycle and link-add mutations are proven only for the trusted local caller; link removal and inbound listing are not proven. Member coverage is limited to message delivery, visibility, and visibility-gated history. The harness is test-only and no production Turso storage route ships.

native.operation.record-read.v1.notes: Historical and enrichment selector parity is not proven.

native.operation.record-history.v1.notes: Global history, run/order selectors, and every caller mode are not proven.

native.operation.snapshot-export.v1.contract: quiesced local unencrypted export_snapshot with mandatory canonical verification
native.operation.snapshot-export.v1.notes: This exact operation scope is narrower than the aggregate native.sqlite-file-fast-path claim.

native.interaction-log.v1.notes: The deterministic Turso harness does not materialize SQLite read_log_calls/read_log_touches; the optional tap must be suppressed.

native.guarded-write.v1.provider: per-logical-database admission gate plus Turso IMMEDIATE transaction and digest re-check

native.search.lexical.v1.provider: Turso FTS (Tantivy) probe; Native ranking adapter not implemented

native.search.semantic.v1.notes: The embedding write seam is dormant and no semantic query adapter ships yet.

native.search.sqlite-fts5-exact.notes: Turso FTS is not SQLite FTS3/4/5.

native.raw-sql.notes: Native query_sql requires sqlite3_set_authorizer, which the Turso API does not expose.

native.describe-physical-schema.provider: TursoHarness-owned DDL plus explicit generated-column and search overlays

native.sqlite-file-fast-path.notes: A quiesced, local, unencrypted file round-trips with stock SQLite; canonical verification is still mandatory.
